I am 43 years old. I never went to school, can't read. I've been farming these 12 mu for 20 years since I married into this village. My mother-in-law taught me, and now I watch what Old Wang and the other neighbors do. My husband and I work the land. My son works in a factory in Shijiazhuang and sends some money home, but fertilizer prices keep going up.

For the wheat: Every year I plant after the National Day holiday in October. I hire the man with the rotary tiller machine — 40 yuan per mu, he does all 12 mu in one morning. Before he comes, I spread one full bag of compound fertilizer on each mu. The bag says 15-15-15 and weighs 50kg. One bag per mu, that's what I've always done. I plant about 15kg of improved wheat seed per mu, the same kind I bought last year from the dealer. In March when the wheat starts growing fast, I spread half a bag of urea on each mu — that's 25kg per mu. Old Wang does the same, and his wheat looks good every year. If it doesn't rain, I run the pump three times: once after planting, once in spring when I put the urea, and once more when the grain is filling. I spray twice — once for weeds when the wheat is small, once later when the dealer says everyone is spraying for rust. Last year I got about 1000 jin per mu, so I expect 500kg per mu this year if the weather holds.

For the corn: Right after we cut the wheat in early June, I plant corn. No time to till again, I plant straight into the wheat stubble. I put half a bag of that same compound fertilizer in the holes when planting — 25kg per mu. I plant hybrid corn seed, about 3kg per mu, whatever the dealer says is selling good. When the corn is knee-high in July, I put another half bag of urea — 25kg per mu. I irrigate twice if no rain: once after planting, once when the tassels come out. I spray twice — once for weeds, once for that corn borer worm. I got about 1200 jin per mu last year, so I expect 600kg per mu.

I don't dare cut back on fertilizer. Last year the corn price was OK. If I use less and lose yield, that's a disaster. Wasting a little fertilizer is just money spent. My neighbor Li cut his fertilizer two years ago and his wheat was terrible. I won't make that mistake.
